correctness.rationale: Reflection across the two transformed line supports forces rational quotient invariance under rotation; finite rotation invariants are C(w^q), and real-line unimodular rational functions have conjugate zero-pole factorization. Rational degree multiplicativity gives exact q-divisibility and matching constructions. Coprime circle equations generate the vanishing ideal, giving (d+1)^2-(d-1)^2=4d real profile dimension. Matching trig traces and 2d sine-product nullspaces give the exact 2x2 determinant. Exact symbolic checker verifies concrete nontrivial configurations, not the universal proof.
